scope: Real disposable local WordPress native cookies, REST nonces and account persistence. No mocked authentication, production changes or real sends.
checks: Actual native cookie/REST nonce saves project; missing nonce cannot read private projects
Second authenticated user cannot read, overwrite or delete first-user project
Cross-device restore/update works on mobile; stale editor recovers from real 409 conflict
Saved stack/projects restore in another native session without exposing them to another user
Unchecked digest consent is rejected; unconfigured follow adapter never claims opt-in
Account deletion removes stack and standalone projects, clears device/other-tab copies, preserves other user
